Name: Run ADK Agent
Author: cbf81976-f755-4f3f-83fd-a1b7e124ac7f
Description: Executes a customized Google ADK Agent that compiles system instructions, reasoning parameters, and optional OSINT search capabilities. Returns structured JSON results to downstream playbook steps while posting agent reasoning and final analysis to the Case Wall.

Parameters.Description: Logical name for the agent instance.
The prompt or instruction to send to the Google ADK Agent.
Thinking budget (token count) for model reasoning (e.g. 1024).
Whether to equip the agent with Google Search for real-time web research.
Whether to equip the agent with persistent long-term memory via Vertex AI Memory Bank.
Optional session identifier to scope memory context. Defaults to active case ID (case_<CaseId>).
